ref_date_note: U (Sep) contract, no roll mentioned. NFP Friday. Pullback day after the 30069 NQ high; ES spike base 7751 (today's low ~5 handles lower, not given -> RTH_LOW), NQ spike base 29702, NQ RTH low 29593 given. No grades anywhere in TRADES; all trades are conditional ideas with tag ''. Targets taken from Trading Higher/Lower commentary where the trade line names none. es3/nq4 'firm reclaim'/'session uptrend above' treated as break; es1 (sellers can't hold below spike base) and nq3 (can't reclaim spike base) treated as fade. 'Shorting 83-87 or 92-95' split into es4 (7783-7787) and es5 (7792-7795) with the same quote. Text 'yesterday's open and low (208 and 235)' kept as zones 29208/29235 (Tuesday's low given elsewhere as 29208). NQ honorable mentions 29785 (776.5-785) and 29803 kept as zones. 'Missed 29969-29994' weekly level from prior plan included.

trades.name: Sellers can't hold below spike base 7751 -> long
trades.quote: Inability from sellers to hold below today’s spike base is a long at least back to 7760-7764. Because the market (and I) loves to punish spikes we have to be open to this as a reclaim of 60-64 can open up some decent range and keep this trend phase active.

trades.name: Failed reclaim of 7760-7764
trades.quote: If 7760-7764 can’t reclaim then, like for today, we can consider shorts but we have to be very careful of the potential for a failed spike. If sellers can’t get through the spike base and today’s low then they can be in trouble.
trades.stop_hint: If sellers can’t get through the spike base and today’s low then they can be in trouble.

trades.name: Firm reclaim of 7760-7764
trades.quote: Reclaim longs on a firm reclaim of 60-64 are more reasonable than usual as it implies a rejection of today’s spike. While buyers couldn’t lift 74-75 this afternoon, we could see some fresh buyers able to do so, emboldened by today’s failed (in that event) spike.

trades.quote: Shorting 83-87 or 92-95 is risky given we would have an implied failed spike but it is valid. I would need to see it in real time to give it consideration

trades.name: Hold of 29540-29569 (possibly LBAF into 29504-29517)
trades.quote: If 540-569 continues to hold and sellers can’t get traction below today’s low then I’ll have to consider a long, especially if ES is constructive. This could see a LBAF into 504-517 first as outlined above. I would be cautious into the 702 spike base and monitor for continuation.
trades.stop_hint: This could see a LBAF into 504-517 first

trades.name: Downtrend short after 29540-29569 flips to resistance
trades.quote: If 540-569 flips to firm resistance I may be willing to join an active downtrend on the short side, cautious that it could be a LBAF.

trades.name: Failed reclaim of 29702 spike base
trades.quote: If buyers cannot reclaim today’s 702 spike base then it is a valid short.

trades.name: Session uptrend above 29702
trades.quote: If we are seeing firm higher lows back above at least 702 then I’ll consider joining a session uptrend on the long side.

trades.name: Short 29891-29910
